source.author: Peter Woit
source.frozen_source: W04c March 10, 2026 original author blog post
source.verbatim_source_role: The SL(2,C)_R is what acts on the CP1s that describe points. The SL(2,C)_L locally acts on the tangent space to the space parametrizing the CP1s.
source.separate_bundle_claim: Above CP3 there’s a canonical line bundle and a three complex dimensional quotient bundle, with a U(1)×U(3) local symmetry.

prior.prior_body: In the revised W04c role assignment SL(2,C)_R acts on the twistor CP1 point data while the left factor acts on tangent/quotient data; after the Wick-rotation choice an SU(2)_L role is interpreted internally.

defect: The current W075 text 'left factor acts on tangent/quotient data' merges the source's SL2C_L tangent-space role with a separate rank-three quotient-bundle description, for which W04c does not assert an SL2C_L action.

repair.replace_exact: left factor acts on tangent/quotient data
repair.with_exact: left factor acts on the tangent space to the space parametrizing the CP1s

negative_evidence: No source-asserted relation identifying SL2C_L action on the rank-three quotient has been located in W04c's original author post. This records missing provenance, not an author claim of mathematical impossibility.
